title: Generative AI for Autonomous Driving: A Review
abstract: arXiv:2505.15863v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) is rapidly advancing the field of Autonomous Driving (AD), extending beyond traditional applications in text, image, and video generation. We explore how generative models can enhance automotive tasks, such as static map creation, dynamic scenario generation, trajectory forecasting, and vehicle motion planning. By examining multiple generative approaches ranging from Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to Generative Transformers (GTs) and Diffusion Models (DMs), we highlight and compare their capabilities and limitations for AD-specific applications. Additionally, we discuss hybrid methods integrating conventional techniques with generative approaches, and emphasize their improved adaptability and robustness. translated_title: 生成式人工智能在自动驾驶中的应用：综述
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）正在迅速推动自动驾驶（AD）领域的发展，其应用已超越传统的文本、图像和视频生成。我们探讨了生成模型如何增强汽车相关任务，例如静态地图创建、动态场景生成、轨迹预测和车辆运动规划。通过考察从变分自编码器（VAE）和生成对抗网络（GAN）到生成式Transformer（GT）和扩散模型（DM）等多种生成方法，我们重点强调并比较了它们在自动驾驶特定应用中的能力与局限性。此外，我们讨论了将传统技术与生成方法相结合的混合方法，并强调了其更强的适应性和鲁棒性。我们还识别了相关数据集，并概述了开放性研究问题，以指导GenAI的未来发展。最后，我们讨论了五个核心挑战：安全性等。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了从VAE、GAN、Transformer到扩散模型等各类生成式AI在自动驾驶的地图创建、场景生成、轨迹预测和运动规划等任务中的应用、优劣比较及未来开放挑战。
en_tdlr: This review systematically examines generative AI models—from VAEs, GANs, and Transformers to diffusion models—for autonomous driving tasks including map creation, scenario generation, trajectory forecasting, and motion planning, comparing their capabilities, limitations, and open challenges.
